Sometimes {npc:Noodles}, {npc:King Tibianus}' dog, runs away from the castle and wanders all over the Thais peninsula. Ask the king for a leash, find Noodles, use the leash on him and go back to the king to receive experience, gold (or, if you are lucky, a {item:Fan Doll of Queen Eloise}) and the achievement Dog Sitter.
The king's beloved dog has disappeared. Help the king find him!
Only while the Mini World Change is active (Noodles has disappeared from the castle).
You can only repeat it every 2 weeks.
One of these: 5 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} (the most common) or {item:Fan Doll of Queen Eloise} (rare)
With luck, a {item:Basket (Puppies)} in the castle (see final step)
The sooner after server save you go looking for Noodles, the easier it is to find him: he wanders over a huge area.
When talking to the king, start with {key:hail king}.

When Noodles runs away, messages like *"Not again! Noodles has taken some royal freedom and left the castle, after him in the name of the king!"* or *"Hear ye! Hear ye! Noodles is gone, the King in despair! Find the little rascal, look everywhere. Bring him back to get rewarded for your care!"* appear. Noodles normally lives in the king's throne room.
2. Asking the king for the leash
Go to the {wiki:Rain Castle} in Thais and talk to {npc:King Tibianus}: {key:hail king}, {key:noodles}, {key:leashes}. He gives you a {item:Dog Collar}.

Noodles can roam the whole Thais peninsula. These are the places where he has been seen appearing at server save. All of them are on the surface, at ground level: you walk there from Thais and walk back to the castle. You don't need a boat or to enter any caves.
North-west of Thais, just behind the castle river
South of Thais, near the Wolf Dungeon
South of Thais, near the Minotaur Camp
South peninsula of the Cyclops Camp
North-east of the Snake Tower guildhall
Outside the city you can find {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Bear|Bears}.
When you find him, use the {item:Dog Collar} on {npc:Noodles}.
Go back to {npc:King Tibianus} and say {key:hail king}, {key:noodles} and {key:reward}.
1,000 experience, 5 Platinum Coins (or, rarely, the Fan Doll of Queen Eloise) and the Dog Sitter achievement
For 2 weeks you can't repeat it: the king won't give you another leash and you can't use another leash on Noodles.

With luck, the {npc:Dog Lady} appears in the Rain Castle after the next server save. While she is in the castle, a {item:Basket (Puppies)|basket of puppies} may appear on the floor of the throne room, south of the pillars on the east side. The basket appears at server save, but it can also reappear if there is a floor reset in that area.
The basket appears south of the pillars on the east side of the throne room
Wiki statistic: out of 735 recorded rewards, 725 were 5 Platinum Coins and 10 were the Fan Doll of Queen Eloise.
